# Fuel filter / water separator (Verado 300 on this boat)

**Status:** From Mercury Verado V8 O&M `8M0145543` (ESN family for `3B371488`).  
**On-boat photo of the filter still useful** to confirm access path with cowl off.

chunks.title: Short answer (this vessel)
chunks.text:
## Short answer (this vessel)

Your Mercury **Verado 300** has an **engine-mounted water‑separating low‑pressure fuel filter**.

| Question | Answer |
|----------|--------|
| Where is it? | Under the **top cowl**, **starboard aft** side of the engine, **near the bottom spark plug** |
| How do I know it needs service? | **Water‑in‑fuel alarm** / Guardian warning; or visible water/contaminants when inspected; also on the maintenance schedule (low‑pressure fuel filter icon) |
| Boat-mounted filter too? | Mercury also mentions a possible **boat-mounted** water‑separating filter. **Not yet confirmed** on HIN `BEYFT208F223` — check the fuel line between tank and engine |
| Related fuse/wiring? | Sensor harness to water‑in‑fuel sensor on the filter (or on boat-mounted filter if that is what is wired) |

chunks.title: When to replace / service
chunks.text:
## When to replace / service

- Service as general maintenance when the **water‑in‑fuel alarm** activates.
- Inspection item on Mercury schedule: check engine-mounted filter for water/contaminants; replace if required. Also check any boat-mounted separator — drain water or replace filter if required.
- Seasonal / “every X hours” items: follow the maintenance schedule decal on the engine (includes low‑pressure fuel filter icon).

chunks.title: Replace outline (engine-mounted filter)
chunks.text:
## Replace outline (engine-mounted filter)

**Safety:** Key OFF, lanyard positioned so engine cannot start; no smoking/sparks; ventilate; collect fuel in approved container; check for leaks before restart.

1. Key OFF; disconnect battery before fuel-system service (Mercury fuel-system precautions).
2. Remove **top cowl**.
3. Locate filter: **starboard aft**, near **bottom spark plug**.
4. Push in fuel hose **release tabs**; disconnect hoses.
5. Disconnect **water‑in‑fuel sensor harness** (note: if a boat-mounted filter has the sensor, harness may go there instead).
6. Rotate filter **clockwise ~1/4 turn** and lift out; empty into approved container.
7. Install: light 2-4-C with PTFE on grommet; install and rotate **counterclockwise 1/4 turn**; reconnect sensor + hoses until locked.
8. Key to RUN; **inspect for leaks** before starting.

Source pages in O&M: Fuel System / Low‑Pressure Fuel Filter (~eng 83–85 in `8M0145543`).

# OM-QS — Quickstart & daily checklist

Print or save this page for the helm binder.

chunks.title: Pre-departure (5 minutes)
chunks.text:
## Pre-departure (5 minutes)

1. **Visual walk-around:** bilge dry / pumps free; no fuel smell; propeller clear; ski pylon clear of lines.
2. **EPHS steering fluid:** reservoir between MIN and MAX (**CONFIRMED** part `8M6005909`). Owner photo previously showed level near MIN — check every outing until stable.
3. **Battery voltages (engine off):** ENGINE and HOUSE ideally ≥12.4 V resting; under 12.2 V → charge before relying on thruster/windlass.
4. **Kill-switch lanyard** clipped to operator and DTS base.
5. **Fuel / water / holding:** know approximate levels (tank 340 L fuel; ~80 L fresh; holding present).
6. **Handheld VHF** charged and aboard (**NOT INSTALLED:** fixed VHF).
7. **Safety gear:** PFDs for all, fire extinguisher, throwable, flares, first aid, anchor rode free to run.

chunks.title: Power-up (cold start) — summary
chunks.text:
## Power-up (cold start) — summary

Full detail: [`chapters/05-power-sequences.md`](chapters/05-power-sequences.md#cold-start-power-up-underway) (`OM-PWR-01`).

1. Battery switch(es) → **ON** (ENGINE + HOUSE as equipped).
2. Confirm no shore-power cord still attached if leaving the dock.
3. Helm master / house breakers as needed → Blue Sea loads (MFD, stereo) as desired.
4. Attach **lanyard**.
5. DTS lever → **NEUTRAL**.
6. Ignition ON → wait for VesselView / SmartCraft self-test / READY.
7. **START** — do not crank continuously more than OEM allows; pause between attempts.
8. Check tell-tale water, no alarms, steering assist present, Zipwake powers, Garmin GPS fix.
9. Thruster test momentary (clear people/lines); windlass free (clutch/brake set for underway).

chunks.text:

| Control | Notes |
|---------|--------|
| DTS **DOCK** | Low-speed docking response |
| DTS **THROTTLE ONLY** | Neutral gear, throttle for wash / warming |
| DTS **TRANSFER** | Multi-engine feature — single engine: leave unused unless prompted |

chunks.title: Power-down — summary
chunks.text:
## Power-down — summary

Full detail: [`chapters/05-power-sequences.md`](chapters/05-power-sequences.md#normal-power-down-shutdown) (`OM-PWR-02`).

1. Idle in neutral; cool briefly after high load if OEM recommends.
2. **STOP** engine; ignition OFF; remove lanyard.
3. Electronics OFF (Garmin, Fusion, Zipwake as desired).
4. Bilge check; raw-water flush of engine if in salt (see Mercury O&M).
5. Battery switch OFF if leaving boat unattended (leave bilge circuit powered if boat design allows — **UNVERIFIED** exact switch topology; confirm at battery switch panel).
6. If on shore power: connect shore cord → AC breakers → confirm CRISTEC **ON** LED.

chunks.title: Shore power (marina) — summary
chunks.text:
## Shore power (marina) — summary

Full detail: `OM-PWR-SHORE`.

1. Engine OFF; battery switches as desired for charging.
2. Shore cord → inlet → pedestal **last**.
3. Confirm **115 V / 60 Hz** panel indicator; RCD/MCB closed.
4. CRISTEC YPOWER `YPO12-25DE` shows charge stage LEDs.
5. Disconnect reverse order: pedestal first, then inlet.

chunks.title: Emergency stops
chunks.text:
## Emergency stops

- **Kill switch / STOP** — engine.
- **Battery switch OFF** — electrical fire (after stopping engine if safe).
- **Shore RCD (30 mA)** — trip = disconnect shore, investigate before reset.
- **Never** ignore continuous warning horn / overheat / low oil — return to idle, investigate.

## Capacity & certification

- Operate within CE category conditions for **C** / **D** as marked on the builder plate.
- Do not exceed **10 persons** or **1285 kg** total load (persons + gear + consumables as defined on the plate / CE handbook).
- Max engine certification for the hull family is **350 HP**; this boat has **300 HP** Verado — within limit.

chunks.title: Always before start
chunks.text:
## Always before start

1. **Lanyard / kill switch** attached to operator (**CONFIRMED** red lanyard on DTS).
2. Ventilation / no gasoline vapors in bilge before cranking.
3. Clear prop and swim platform of people, lines, tow ropes.
4. Know location of fire extinguisher and manual bilge pump.

chunks.title: Carbon monoxide & exhaust
chunks.text:
## Carbon monoxide & exhaust

Outboard exhaust can still accumulate in cockpit/cabin in certain wind/idle conditions. Do not occupy enclosed spaces with engine idling for long periods. Maintain cabin ventilation.

chunks.title: Fuel system
chunks.text:
## Fuel system

- Tank capacity **340 L**.
- US boat carries **EPA EVAP** compliance plate — maintain evaporative system integrity (caps, hoses, carbon canister if fitted).
- Stop engine and extinguish flames before fueling; no smoking.

chunks.title: Electrical safety
chunks.text:
## Electrical safety

- Diagram warning: **TURN OFF POWER BEFORE SERVICING.**
- Shore system includes **30 mA** RCD (Schneider iDPN N Vigi C32) — never bypass.
- After water ingress into electrical spaces: disconnect shore and batteries before drying/inspection.
- Blue Sea **VHF** fuse circuit exists but **no fixed VHF** is installed — do not assume a DSC fixed radio is available for distress.

chunks.title: Steering & control
chunks.text:
## Steering & control

- Steering is **electro-hydraulic (EPHS)**, not pure steer-by-wire. Loss of assist increases helm effort — slow down, use both hands, return to dock.
- Keep EPHS fluid between MIN and MAX with Mercury-specified fluid only.
- If DTS alarms or shifts fail: stay in **NEUTRAL**, use **STOP**, deploy anchor if needed, call for assistance.

chunks.title: Trim & stability
chunks.text:
## Trim & stability

- **Zipwake** interceptors change running attitude. In following seas or when learning the boat, understand AUTO vs manual modes (see Zipwake operator manual).
- **LENCO is NOT INSTALLED** — do not follow LENCO procedures.

chunks.title: Communications
chunks.text:
## Communications

- Primary radio: **handheld VHF** only.
- Carry charged spare battery / power bank for handheld.
- Cell coverage is not a substitute for VHF in coastal distress where DSC/coast guard watch is expected — consider adding a fixed DSC VHF later (pre-wire fuse present).

chunks.title: Towing / ski pylon
chunks.text:
## Towing / ski pylon

- Stainless ski/tow pylon **CONFIRMED**. Use only for intended water-sports tow loads; inspect fasteners; keep observers clear of rope snap-back.

chunks.title: Teak decks
chunks.text:
## Teak decks

- Real teak can be slippery when wet/oily — use appropriate footwear; rinse salt.

# OM-PWR — Power sequences

These sequences are written for **this** Flyer 8 SPACEdeck: dual IMNASA banks, Mercury DTS Verado 300, Zipwake, Sleipner, Garmin/Fusion, CRISTEC shore charging, handheld VHF only.

Where battery-switch labeling is not yet photographed, steps say “battery switch(es)” — confirm the physical panel legend on your boat and annotate this file.

---

chunks.title: Cold-start / power-up (underway)
chunks.text:
## Cold-start / power-up (underway)

**ID:** `OM-PWR-01`

chunks.title: A. Electrical wake-up
chunks.text:
### A. Electrical wake-up
1. Walk-around clear; bilge OK; no fuel odor.
2. **Shore power disconnected** if leaving the slip (pedestal → then inlet).
3. Turn **ENGINE** battery circuit **ON**.
4. Turn **HOUSE** battery circuit **ON** (needed for thruster, windlass, house loads, electronics).
5. If a combine/parallel switch exists (**UNVERIFIED**), leave in normal/isolate cruise position unless starting with a weak engine battery per OEM procedure.
6. Energize helm breakers / Blue Sea loads as needed:
   - **HDS 5 A** — Garmin
   - **AN4 10 A** — Fusion (optional at start)
   - **JF 3 A** — helm feeds

chunks.title: B. Helm & networks
chunks.text:
### B. Helm & networks
7. Clip **kill lanyard** to DTS and operator.
8. Place DTS lever in **NEUTRAL** (required for start).
9. Ignition **ON** (do not crank yet).
10. Wait for:
    - VesselView / SmartCraft self-test complete
    - No persistent critical alarms
    - Garmin boot + GPS acquiring
    - Zipwake panel powered
11. Optional: Fusion on; thruster panel armed only when ready to maneuver.

chunks.title: C. Engine start
chunks.text:
### C. Engine start
12. Press **START** (or key start per helm).
13. Release at first fire; do not continuous-crank beyond Mercury limits — wait ≥30–60 s between long attempts.
14. Verify:
    - Tell-tale cooling water stream
    - Oil pressure / no overheat icons
    - Voltage climbing toward ~13.8–14.6 V when charging (underway photo previously ~14.2–14.4 V)
    - Steering assist present (wheel effort normal)
15. Idle warm-up as required by Mercury O&M / water temperature.
16. Check trim: engine trim switch + Zipwake status (AUTO PITCH / AUTO ROLL as desired).

chunks.title: D. Get-away checks
chunks.text:
### D. Get-away checks
17. Nav / anchor lights as required.
18. Brief thruster bump clear of dock lines.
19. Windlass: confirm anchor stowed/latched before planning sea way.
20. Handheld VHF on and on the working channel.

---

chunks.title: Normal power-down / shutdown
chunks.text:
## Normal power-down / shutdown

**ID:** `OM-PWR-02`

1. Approach in **DOCK** mode if desired; thruster as needed.
2. DTS → **NEUTRAL**; idle.
3. After high-speed run, allow a short cool-down idle if Mercury guidance for that session applies.
4. **STOP** engine.
5. Ignition **OFF**; remove lanyard (store where it will be found next trip).
6. Zipwake OFF / sleep per its UI if required.
7. Garmin → home/shutdown; Fusion OFF.
8. Thruster panel OFF / disarmed.
9. Switch off unused house loads (fridge may stay on if provisioned and batteries healthy).
10. Bilge check; pump as needed.
11. Saltwater: **flush engine** with flush port / earmuffs per Verado O&M.
12. Battery switches:
    - Leaving boat hours/days: typically **OFF** main banks.
    - If automatic bilge must remain live, leave only the dedicated bilge feed powered (**confirm** your switch design — **UNVERIFIED**).
13. Lockers closed; shore power optional (next section).

---

chunks.title: Overnight on the hard / trailer / dry storage
chunks.text:
## Overnight on the hard / trailer / dry storage

1. Complete `OM-PWR-02`.
2. Shore power optional for CRISTEC maintenance charge — only if:
   - Cord and inlet dry/acceptable
   - RCD functional
   - Battery chemistry matches charger profile
3. Prefer float/maintenance once batteries full; do not ignore CRISTEC fault LEDs.
4. For long storage: follow Mercury fogging/fuel/storage sections; consider battery maintainer strategy.

---

chunks.title: Shore power connect / disconnect
chunks.text:
## Shore power connect / disconnect

**ID:** `OM-PWR-SHORE`

chunks.title: Connect
chunks.text:
### Connect
1. Engine **OFF**.
2. Inspect cord (no cracked insulation); use **15/30 A marine** cord appropriate to inlet (**UNVERIFIED** inlet amperage stamp — read the inlet plate).
3. Connect cord to **boat inlet** first.
4. Connect to **pedestal** last; turn pedestal breaker ON.
5. At AC panel: confirm Schneider **iIL** indicator; close RCD/MCBs if open.
6. Confirm CRISTEC **ON** LED; note Boost / Absorption / Floating stage.
7. DC: battery switches ON if you want banks to accept charge (normal).

chunks.title: Disconnect
chunks.text:
### Disconnect
1. Turn off pedestal breaker / unplug **pedestal end first**.
2. Then remove from boat inlet; cap inlet.
3. Coil cord out of walkways.

chunks.title: If RCD trips
chunks.text:
### If RCD trips
1. Do not repeatedly reset.
2. Disconnect shore.
3. Dry/inspect inlet and charger area.
4. Try with charger/outlet breakers isolated to localize (ABB C16 circuits vs charger path).
5. See troubleshooting `shore_power_issues`.

---

chunks.title: Emergency electrical shutdown
chunks.text:
## Emergency electrical shutdown

**Order when safe:**
1. Engine **STOP** / lanyard.
2. Shore pedestal OFF / unplug if connected.
3. Battery switches **OFF**.
4. Fight fire with appropriate extinguisher; abandon if needed.

chunks.title: OM-TS — Troubleshooting master
chunks.text:
# OM-TS — Troubleshooting master

**How to use:** find the symptom heading → follow steps in order → open linked OEM PDF only when needed.  
**LLM:** prefer matching `llm/symptom-playbooks.yaml` IDs; cite section IDs below.

Safety: kill power before probing fuses; keep clear of prop; treat fuel vapors seriously.

---

chunks.title: No start / hard start
chunks.text:
## No start / hard start

**ID:** `OM-TS-NOSTART` · Hardware: engine, DTS, batteries

1. **Lanyard** attached? Clip and retry.
2. DTS in **NEUTRAL**? Out-of-neutral blocks start.
3. Battery switches **ON** (ENGINE at minimum).
4. Measure ENGINE battery voltage:
   - <11.5 V while cranking attempt → charge/boost/replace; check terminals.
   - OK voltage but slow crank → connections / starter cable / corroded grounds.
5. Ignition ON: does VesselView power? Any **security / fault** text?
6. Listen: click only vs cranks vs no sound.
7. **THROTTLE ONLY** / flooded procedures only per Mercury O&M — do not invent.
8. If cranks but no fire: fuel level, primer/EFI faults, CDS dealer diagnostics (PCM 112).
9. After any work: confirm tell-tale on successful start.

Manuals: Verado O&M `8M0145543`; SmartCraft overview.

---

chunks.title: Heavy or no power steering
chunks.text:
## Heavy or no power steering

**ID:** `OM-TS-STEER` · Hardware: EPHS `8M6005909`

1. Confirm engine running (assist may differ key-on vs running — note behavior).
2. Check EPHS reservoir **MIN–MAX**; top up with **Mercury-specified** fluid only.
3. Look for leaks at pump, hoses, steering ram.
4. JF/helm 3 A fuse intact? (may feed related electronics — not the pump main).
5. SmartCraft steering alarm on VesselView? Record exact text.
6. If fluid OK and alarm persists → Mercury dealer EPHS diagnosis.

Photo previously near MIN — check first.

---

chunks.title: Overheat / cooling
chunks.text:
## Overheat / cooling

**ID:** `OM-TS-OVERHEAT`

1. Idle immediately; verify **tell-tale**.
2. No tell-tale → intake blockage, impeller, flush port left open, exhaust issue.
3. Debris in intake screens / bag in prop hub area.
4. Temperature icon + horn → do not re-engage WOT.
5. After cooling: inspect; impeller service per hours/time in O&M.
6. Persistent → dealer pressure/temperature diagnostics.

---

chunks.title: No shift / stuck neutral / DTS oddness
chunks.text:
## No shift / stuck neutral / DTS oddness

1. Lever calibration / neutral detent — don’t force.
2. Note beep codes / VesselView messages.
3. Battery voltage stable?
4. Check for **THROTTLE ONLY** accidentally engaged.
5. Cycle ignition; if still failed → SmartCraft/DTS dealer tools.
6. Never disconnect shift actuators randomly underway.

---

chunks.title: Zipwake / handling
chunks.text:
## Zipwake / handling

**ID:** `OM-TS-TRIM`

1. Confirm Zipwake panel power (house DC).
2. Errors on display — record code; see Zipwake operator manual.
3. GPS missing/slow → AUTO modes degraded; check Garmin GPS fix / NMEA.
4. One interceptor not moving → obstruction, wiring, actuator (haul inspection).
5. Boat still porpoises: engine trim + Zipwake interaction; load distribution; sea state.
6. Remember **LENCO is not installed**.

---

chunks.title: Thruster dead or weak
chunks.text:
## Thruster dead or weak

**ID:** `OM-TS-THRUSTER`

1. Panel ON? Joystick enabled?
2. Voltage at rest and during command — sag to <10.5 V ≈ weak bank/cables.
3. Locate **dedicated thruster breaker** (not Blue Sea 3–10 A) — reset once.
4. Solenoid chatter → low voltage or failing contacts.
5. Runtime cutout — wait cool-down.
6. No prop spin but voltage OK → motor/tunnel inspection hauled.

---

chunks.title: Windlass won’t haul
chunks.text:
## Windlass won’t haul

**ID:** `OM-TS-WINDLASS`

1. Power/breakers ON; control switches tested (helm + bow if both).
2. Voltage under load.
3. Contactor click but no motor → motor/brushes/connections.
4. Motor runs but gypsy slips → clutch adjustment / worn gypsy / wrong chain.
5. Anchor stuck → motor to rode, don’t stall windlass.
6. Identify brand plate to use correct Lewmar/other procedure.

---

chunks.title: Water pumps (no pressure / cycling)
chunks.text:
## Water pumps (no pressure / cycling)

**ID:** `OM-TS-PUMP`

chunks.title: Fresh (Jabsco 31395-7008)
chunks.text:
### Fresh (Jabsco 31395-7008)
1. Water in tank?
2. Circuit **1P2B** / 10 A device fuse.
3. Strainer clogged?
4. Air leak on suction → priming issues.
5. Runs on forever → leak downstream or switch fault.
6. Thermal cutout — cool and find cause (dry run / blockage).

chunks.title: Washdown (Flojet R4325143F)
chunks.text:
### Washdown (Flojet R4325143F)
1. Seacock/intake open if raw-water (**UNVERIFIED** seacock label — confirm).
2. 15 A fuse; strainer.
3. Same cycling logic as above.

chunks.text:
## Fridge warm

**ID:** `OM-TS-FRIDGE`

1. Confirm fridge exists and switch ON.
2. Check **1C1A** heavy feed / main fuse.
3. Voltage >12 V while running.
4. Compressor click/no-start → low V or fault.
5. Ventilation around compressor.
6. Identify Isotherm/other label for model-specific faults.

---

chunks.title: Garmin blank or no sonar
chunks.text:
## Garmin blank or no sonar

**ID:** `OM-TS-MFD`

1. Blue Sea **HDS 5 A** fuse.
2. Battery switches / dimmer / power button hold.
3. GPS OK but sonar dead → transducer connector/power/temp.
4. Depth lost only at speed → transducer aeration/placement/damage.
5. Software: Garmin support + About screen model.

---

chunks.title: Stereo dead
chunks.text:
## Stereo dead

**ID:** `OM-TS-AUDIO`

1. Blue Sea **AN4 10 A**.
2. Fusion power button / voltage at unit.
3. Speaker cutouts only → speaker wiring / protection mode.
4. Bluetooth pairing per MS-RA210 manual.

---

chunks.title: Shore power / no charge
chunks.text:
## Shore power / no charge

1. Pedestal live? Another boat’s cord tested?
2. Connect order correct? RCD tripped?
3. Schneider indicator lit?
4. CRISTEC ON LED? Hot case / error blink — see YPOWER manual.
5. Profile vs battery chemistry mismatch.
6. DC fuses/links between charger and banks (**UNVERIFIED** locations — trace/photo).

---

chunks.text:
## Blank engine data

1. VesselView blank but engine runs → display power/network.
2. VesselView OK, Garmin overlay missing → NMEA/gateway settings.
3. Both blank + no start → power/SmartCraft backbone.

## Rules

1. **Cite** section IDs (`OM-PWR-01`, `OM-TS-NOSTART`, `OM-WIRE-BLUESEA`, hardware ids like `engine-verado-300-v8`).
2. Distinguish **CONFIRMED** vs **LIKELY** vs **UNVERIFIED** vs **NOT INSTALLED**. Never present unverified model numbers as fact.
3. **Do not invent** fuse ratings, fluid part numbers, wire colors, or torque values. If missing, say what photo/label is needed.
4. Prefer **safety-first** steps: lanyard, prop clear, fuel vapors, RCD, battery disconnect before service.
5. For faults, follow playbooks step-by-step; ask for voltage readings, alarm text, and fuse numbers when needed.
6. Remember electrical quirks: fuse code **HDS** feeds **Garmin**; **VHF** fuse is unused; thruster/windlass use **dedicated** high-current protection not shown on Blue Sea aux.
7. When recommending manuals, give repo-relative PDF paths from `chapters/16-manuals-map.md`.
8. If the user describes aftermarket changes, update assumptions only after confirmation — baseline is factory/dealer optioned US boat.
9. Refuse unsafe requests (defeating kill switch, bypassing RCD, dumping waste illegally).
10. Keep answers operational and concise unless the user asks for deep detail.

chunks.title: Power-down sequence summary
chunks.text:
Power-down: neutral idle; STOP; ignition off; remove lanyard; electronics off; bilge check; salt flush engine; battery switches off
unless dedicated bilge must stay live (verify switch design). Shore optional for CRISTEC charge.

chunks.title: Shore connect order
chunks.text:
Connect: engine off; cord to boat inlet first; pedestal last; confirm indicator/RCD; CRISTEC ON LED.
Disconnect: pedestal first then inlet. Never bypass 30mA RCD.

chunks.title: Helm equipment
chunks.text:
Helm confirmed: Garmin MFD (model TBD), Mercury VesselView-class display (model TBD), Fusion stereo (likely MS-RA210),
Mercury DTS with DOCK/TRANSFER/THROTTLE ONLY + red lanyard, Zipwake AUTO PITCH/AUTO ROLL + rotary, Sleipner thruster panel+joystick,
offshore compass. No fixed VHF. LENCO not installed.

chunks.title: Zipwake trim
chunks.text:
Zipwake Series S confirmed with AUTO PITCH and AUTO ROLL. Factory alternative LENCO is NOT installed.
Interceptors stabilize pitch/roll; engine Active Trim is separate. See Zipwake Series S operator manual.

chunks.title: Water pumps
chunks.text:
Washdown: Flojet R4325143F S/N 22C53625 12V 4.5GPM 12A max 40PSI fuse 15A.
Fresh: Jabsco PAR-MAX 2.9 31395-7008 S/N 22A45914 12V 2.9GPM 5.2A max 40PSI fuse 10A.
Both in battery locker with strainers.

chunks.title: Holding tank
chunks.text:
Polyethylene HOLDING tank confirmed in battery locker; handwritten 80L EF unverified; US list 88L blackwater.
MACER circuit 3P1A on fuse diagram. Toilet brand unverified (Jabsco candidate). Observe NDZ laws.

chunks.title: Bow thruster
chunks.text:
Sleipner/Side-Power bow thruster confirmed at helm. Exact SE40/SE60 model unverified.
Uses dedicated high-current breaker not Blue Sea aux. Short bursts; watch voltage sag.

chunks.title: Windlass
chunks.text:
Electric windlass confirmed with stainless plow/Delta-style anchor on bow roller.
Brand/model and chain size unverified (Lewmar candidate manual). Dedicated breaker expected near batteries.

chunks.title: Teak deck
chunks.text:
Owner confirmed real teak on cockpit and swim platforms — factory solid wood/teck option class.
Not synthetic SeaDek/Flexiteek. Rinse salt; care differs from foam decking.

chunks.title: T-Top and ski
chunks.text:
Black T-Top with fabric roof and 4 aft rod holders confirmed. Black pulpits confirmed.
Stainless ski/tow pylon U-arch over engine confirmed. Elegance grey/cognac upholstery. Cockpit table present.

chunks.title: Symptom to fuse hints
chunks.text:
Quick fuse hints: stereo→AN4 10A; Garmin→HDS 5A; fresh pump→1P2B/10A; washdown→Flojet 15A;
macerator→3P1A; bilge→4P1A; fridge→1C1A; fixed VHF→not installed.

chunks.title: Ruled out equipment
chunks.text:
NOT INSTALLED on this vessel: LENCO trim tabs (Zipwake instead); Mastervolt charger (CRISTEC instead);
fixed VHF radio (handheld only; Blue Sea VHF fuse is spare/pre-wire).

chunks.title: Stock vs options
chunks.text:
Reads as US Trim Package + electronics/sound + Zipwake + thruster + deck wash + T-Top/ski + teak + Verado 300.
Clear later-added: SAN DIEGO CA seat lettering. Need dealer build sheet for HIN for 100% proof.

chunks.title: Safety limits
chunks.text:
Max 10 persons / 1285 kg. Always use kill lanyard. Do not bypass 30mA shore RCD.
Handheld VHF only for radio. Real teak slippery when wet. EPHS fluid loss reduces steering assist.

# Symptom playbooks — machine-readable troubleshooting trees
# Each playbook: id, aliases, hardware_ids, safety, steps[], next_photos[], manuals[]

version: "1.0.0"
vessel_hin: "BEYFT208F223"
engine_esn: "3B371488"

playbooks:
  - id: PB-NOSTART
    om_section: OM-TS-NOSTART
    aliases: [no start, won't start, will not crank, hard start, click no start]
    hardware_ids: [engine-verado-300-v8, dts-controls, electrical_baseline]
    safety:
      - "Clear prop and ensure neutral before cranking"
      - "No fuel smell in bilge before ignition"
    steps:
      - "Confirm kill lanyard clipped to DTS and operator"
      - "Confirm DTS lever in NEUTRAL"
      - "ENGINE battery switch ON; measure resting voltage (want ≥12.4 V)"
      - "Ignition ON — does VesselView power? Note any fault text"
      - "Attempt START — note: no sound / click / slow crank / cranks no fire"
      - "If low voltage or slow crank: clean terminals, charge ENGINE bank, retry"
      - "If cranks no fire: check fuel quantity; follow Mercury flooded/EFI guidance in O&M — do not invent"
      - "Persistent: Mercury dealer CDS/PCM 112 diagnostics for ESN 3B371488"
    next_photos: ["battery switch panel labels", "VesselView fault screen", "ENGINE battery CCA label"]
    manuals:
      - manuals/engine/Mercury-Verado-V8-SeaPro-V8-Operation-Maintenance-8m0145543.pdf
      - manuals/engine/Mercury-SmartCraft-Operation-Overview-8m0071455r.pdf

  - id: PB-STEER
    om_section: OM-TS-STEER
    aliases: [hard steering, heavy steering, no power steering, stiff wheel, EPHS]
    hardware_ids: [steering-power]
    safety:
      - "Reduce speed if assist lost; both hands on wheel"
    steps:
      - "Check EPHS reservoir 8M6005909 between MIN and MAX"
      - "Top up only with Mercury-specified synthetic steering fluid"
      - "Inspect for leaks at pump/hoses/ram"
      - "Note VesselView steering alarms verbatim"
      - "Check Blue Sea JF 3A as related helm feed — not pump main"
      - "If fluid drops again or alarm persists: dealer EPHS service"
    next_photos: ["EPHS reservoir level", "fluid P/N from O&M or bottle"]
    manuals:
      - manuals/engine/Mercury-Electric-Steering-V8-V10-AMS-8m0221736.pdf
      - manuals/engine/Mercury-Verado-V8-SeaPro-V8-Operation-Maintenance-8m0145543.pdf

  - id: PB-OVERHEAT
    om_section: OM-TS-OVERHEAT
    aliases: [overheat, hot engine, no tell tale, no water stream, temperature alarm]
    hardware_ids: [engine-verado-300-v8]
    safety:
      - "Idle immediately; do not continue WOT with overheat alarm"
    steps:
      - "Verify tell-tale stream present"
      - "Clear intake / bag / plastic from water inlets"
      - "Check flush port closed"
      - "Allow cool-down; inspect impeller service interval"
      - "If repeats: dealer cooling system diagnosis"
    next_photos: ["tell-tale while idling", "VesselView temp alarm"]
    manuals:
      - manuals/engine/Mercury-Verado-V8-SeaPro-V8-Operation-Maintenance-8m0145543.pdf

  - id: PB-DTS-SHIFT
    om_section: OM-TS
    aliases: [no shift, stuck neutral, won't go into gear, throttle only stuck, DTS beep]
    hardware_ids: [dts-controls, engine-verado-300-v8]
    steps:
      - "Confirm THROTTLE ONLY not engaged unintentionally"
      - "Record beep pattern / VesselView message"
      - "Check battery voltage stability"
      - "Cycle ignition in neutral; retry"
      - "Dealer SmartCraft/DTS diagnostics if unresolved"
    manuals:
      - manuals/engine/Mercury-Electric-Steering-V8-V10-AMS-8m0221736.pdf

  - id: PB-ZIPWAKE
    om_section: OM-TS-TRIM
    aliases: [zipwake error, auto pitch fail, listing, porpoising, interceptor stuck, trim tabs]
    hardware_ids: [zipwake]
    notes:
      - "LENCO is NOT INSTALLED on this boat"
    steps:
      - "Confirm Zipwake panel powered"
      - "Record on-screen error codes"
      - "Confirm Garmin GPS fix if AUTO modes misbehave"
      - "Visually inspect interceptor blades for damage/obstruction when possible"
      - "Review engine trim vs Zipwake interaction"
      - "Consult Zipwake operator manual for code-specific actions"
    manuals:
      - manuals/systems/Zipwake-Series-S-Operators-Manual-EN-R5A.pdf

  - id: PB-THRUSTER
    om_section: OM-TS-THRUSTER
    aliases: [thruster dead, bow thruster weak, sleipner, side-power no thrust]
    hardware_ids: [bow-thruster, electrical_baseline]
    steps:
      - "Arm Sleipner panel; test joystick short burst"
      - "Measure battery voltage at rest and during command"
      - "Find and check dedicated thruster breaker (not Blue Sea aux 3-10A)"
      - "If thermal cutout: wait and retry with shorter bursts"
      - "Haul inspection if mechanical noise or no rotation with voltage OK"
    next_photos: ["thruster main breaker", "motor plate SE model"]
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/Side-Power-SE-SE-IP-DC-User-Manual-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-WINDLASS
    om_section: OM-TS-WINDLASS
    aliases: [windlass dead, won't haul, anchor winch, breaker trips windlass]
    hardware_ids: [windlass, electrical_baseline]
    steps:
      - "Confirm HOUSE/ENGINE power and windlass breaker ON"
      - "Test helm and bow controls if both exist"
      - "Voltage under load; listen for contactor click"
      - "If motor runs but no haul: clutch/gypsy/chain match"
      - "Free stuck anchor by motoring up — do not stall windlass"
    next_photos: ["windlass motor plate", "chain size", "breaker location"]
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/Lewmar-Pro-Series-Pro-Fish-Windlass-Manual.pdf

  - id: PB-FRESH-PUMP
    om_section: OM-TS-PUMP
    aliases: [no water pressure, fresh pump, jabsco, par-max, shower no pressure]
    hardware_ids: [freshwater-pump]
    steps:
      - "Verify water in 80 L tank"
      - "Check 1P2B circuit / 10A device fuse for Jabsco 31395-7008"
      - "Clean inlet strainer"
      - "Listen for continuous run (leak) vs rapid cycle (air/leak) vs silence (no power)"
      - "Allow thermal reset if overheated from dry run"
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/Jabsco-PAR-MAX-2.9-Manual-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-WASHDOWN
    om_section: OM-TS-PUMP
    aliases: [washdown dead, deck wash, flojet, no washdown pressure]
    hardware_ids: [deck-wash]
    steps:
      - "Confirm washdown seacock/intake open if raw-water (verify on boat)"
      - "Check 15A device fuse for Flojet R4325143F"
      - "Clean strainer"
      - "Same cycle/leak logic as fresh pump"
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/Flojet-Washdown-Pump-Manual-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-FRIDGE
    om_section: OM-TS-FRIDGE
    aliases: [fridge warm, refrigerator not cold, isotherm]
    hardware_ids: [cabin-fridge, electrical_baseline]
    steps:
      - "Confirm unit installed and switched ON"
      - "Check main panel heavy feed 1C1A 4mm² path"
      - "Measure voltage at fridge while attempting to run"
      - "Check compressor ventilation"
      - "Identify brand label for model-specific manual"
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/Isotherm-Cruise-42-130-Install-Operating-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-GARMIN
    om_section: OM-TS-MFD
    aliases: [garmin blank, no sonar, no gps, depth lost, MFD dead]
    hardware_ids: [garmin-echomap]
    steps:
      - "Check Blue Sea HDS 5A fuse (feeds Garmin — code says HDS but unit is Garmin)"
      - "Battery switches ON; hold power button per Garmin manual"
      - "If GPS OK but sonar dead: transducer connector/cable"
      - "Depth lost at speed: aeration/transducer damage"
      - "Capture Settings → System → About for exact model"
    manuals:
      - manuals/electronics/Garmin-ECHOMAP-UHD-Owners-Manual-EN.pdf
      - manuals/electronics/Garmin-ECHOMAP-UHD2-62-72-92sv-Owners-Manual-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-STEREO
    om_section: OM-TS-AUDIO
    aliases: [stereo dead, fusion dead, no bluetooth audio]
    hardware_ids: [fusion-audio]
    steps:
      - "Check Blue Sea AN4 10A fuse"
      - "Power cycle Fusion head unit"
      - "Verify voltage at unit"
      - "Speaker-only faults: wiring / protection mode per Fusion manual"
    manuals:
      - manuals/electronics/Fusion-MS-RA210-Owners-Manual-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-SHORE
    om_section: OM-PWR-SHORE
    aliases: [no shore power, not charging, RCD trip, cristec off, shore power issues]
    hardware_ids: [shore-power-charger]
    safety:
      - "Do not bypass 30mA RCD"
      - "Disconnect pedestal first if unsafe"
    steps:
      - "Verify marina pedestal live"
      - "Connect boat inlet first, pedestal last"
      - "Check Schneider iIL indicator and RCD not tripped"
      - "CRISTEC ON LED and charge stage LEDs"
      - "Confirm battery switches allow charge acceptance"
      - "Verify charger profile matches actual battery chemistry (sticker currently OPENED TYPE)"
      - "Isolate ABB C16 circuits vs charger to localize trips"
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/CRISTEC-YPOWER-User-Manual-EN.pdf

  - id: PB-ENGINE-DATA
    om_section: OM-TS
    aliases: [blank engine data, no rpm on display, vesselview blank]
    hardware_ids: [vesselview-or-gauges, garmin-echomap, dts-controls]
    steps:
      - "Does VesselView power on key-on?"
      - "If VesselView OK but Garmin overlay missing: NMEA/gateway settings"
      - "If both blank and no start: follow PB-NOSTART power checks"
      - "Photograph display bezel for exact VesselView model"

  - id: PB-TOILET
    om_section: OM-WATER-WASTE
    aliases: [toilet won't flush, macerator, holding tank, head fail]
    hardware_ids: [electric-toilet]
    steps:
      - "Fresh water available for flush?"
      - "Check MACER 3P1A circuit if discharge pump inoperative"
      - "Confirm tank not full; locate pump-out deck fitting"
      - "Photograph toilet brand/model before applying Jabsco-specific steps"
    manuals:
      - manuals/peripherals/Jabsco-37010-Electric-Toilet-Manual-EN.pdf
